sustained_load_classification.result: device resource limit, not a wtctl defect
basis: single MIPS core at 98.7-99.9% CPU in all three 30-minute runs
reverse TCP stream error-free in all runs (about 470-480 MB each)
forward TCP 117/117 when echoes ran on the device; earlier forward failures coincide with SSH logins refused under saturation
no tunnel client restarts, no supervisor events, no OOM; control kept serving the accepted configuration
reverse UDP lost nothing with the device idle (10 x 500 datagrams); occasional UDP probe failures only at saturation, which UDP does not retransmit

incidents: Device clock was about 9 h 50 min slow; a lab certificate issued at the current time was rejected (first apply rolled back on confirmation-timeout). Certificates were reissued with notBefore two days earlier; the device clock was not changed.
Boot-outage script asserted on a status read during early boot; the test resumed from that step without a second reboot.
cleanup: wtctl uninstall --purge --yes; test files removed; /etc/passwd and /etc/config/* identical to baseline; lab containers, image, network and volume removed.
